about: Frozen 2026-11-10, written AFTER the 'failed to stop' pointer and the widened flee words (the first narrative set is a development set now). Run ONCE, no tuning afterwards. Written by Claude (not a lawyer).
fled: My client, a lorry driver from Nanded, is accused of causing the death of a farmer who was walking on the shoulder of the national highway. The prosecution says that after the lorry struck him the driver carried on towards Hyderabad without halting. He gave himself up three days later. What charges and what bail position?

At about 10 pm my client's car collided with a scooter on the ring road. The scooter rider, a young man, fell and later died. My client says he panicked, took the car home and informed the police next morning. Advise on the offences and on bail.

The accused, a dumper driver, ran over a labourer sleeping near a construction site and drove off. The labourer's body was found at dawn. CCTV footage identified the dumper. What can the driver be charged with, and can he get bail?

Our client's tempo traveller hit a cyclist at the village chowk and the driver, afraid of the crowd, left the place immediately. The cyclist has a skull injury and is on a ventilator. Which sections come in and what is the bail position?

A taxi driver hit a pedestrian on the airport road and carried on to drop his passenger at the terminal, as he said he feared missing the flight. The pedestrian died. He was arrested the next day. Advise.

My client, a school bus driver, struck a child at the school gate while reversing, realised it, but ran away from the scene because a mob had gathered. He later surrendered. The child has a broken leg. What offences apply and what are the bail chances?
others: My client, a lorry driver, is accused of smuggling red sandalwood hidden under cement bags. He was arrested at the check post. What are the grounds for bail?
The accused, a car owner, is alleged to have defrauded an insurance company by claiming for a car that was never stolen. He was arrested yesterday. Advise on offences and bail.
My client, a bus conductor, is accused of molesting a woman passenger in a crowded bus. He was arrested on the spot by the police. What provisions apply and what is the bail position?
A dumper owner is accused of paying a bribe to the traffic inspector to avoid the penalty for overloading. What offences apply?
